name: Barbell Wrist Curl
steps: Kneel beside a bench and support your forearms on it with palms up and the bar just beyond the edge.
Bend your wrists to draw the bar toward your forearms.
Let the bar descend slowly without lifting your forearms from the pad.
tips: Keep your fingers closed securely around the bar and forearms flat on the bench.
Pause briefly at the top of each curl rather than bouncing the bar.
